name: design
description: Design exploration rounds for marketing sites and product UI: interview the owner into a direction brief with saved references, fan it out into independent HTML variants built by different skills and models, gate first drafts with fresh-context critics that push toward each premise instead of the mean, review every direction in a local gallery with its brief, references, design system, and variants, edit variants in the page with impeccable live, and carry what the owner wants into the next brief.
